_comment: GAOS™ v3.4 config (34 modules + AI failover). Copy to config.json and fill in real values. Secrets can also be set as environment variables (e.g. DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY).

deepseek._comment: Optional: Primary or fallback AI provider. Get key at: platform.deepseek.com — typical usage ~£2-5/month. Leave as 'YOUR_DEEPSEEK_KEY_HERE' to disable.

groq._comment: Recommended: FREE TIER fallback AI. Sign up at: groq.com — no credit card required. If both are configured, Groq is primary (it's free). Leave as 'YOUR_GROQ_KEY_HERE' to disable.

gmail._comment: watch_inbox: the Gmail account GAOS monitors. alert_email: where to send alerts.

google_sheets._comment: The shared Google Sheet where all module data is stored. Must be shared with the service account email.

twilio._comment: Twilio credentials for SMS, WhatsApp, and Voice modules. Leave placeholders to disable SMS/WhatsApp features.

slack._comment: Optional Slack integration for alerts and digests. Leave as placeholder to disable.

business.name: Spud
business._comment: Business details used in AI prompts, emails, and conversational modules.

_active_roles_comment: Which CUSTOMER roles this instance runs. Internal modules (25-26, 29-31, 35-36) always run on full_team. Remove roles from this list to disable them.

server._allowed_origins_comment: CORS origins for embedded chatbot widget. Leave empty [] to allow all (*). Set to specific domains to restrict: ['https://example.com', 'https://app.example.com']
